title: Adrenal Gland Anatomy
text: The adrenal glands sit on top of the kidneys. Each has two parts: the outer cortex (produces cortisol) and the inner medulla (produces adrenaline/noradrenaline).

title: Rapid Response System
text: Unlike most endocrine responses, the adrenal medulla is directly controlled by the sympathetic nervous system, allowing near-instant hormone release during emergencies.
